pages.text: Returns a part of a text.$(br2)Positions start at 0. Near the end you get fewer characters. A start behind the end gives an empty text. A negative start or length raises INVALID_ARGUMENT.

$(li)$(1)text$() STRING: the text$(li)$(1)start$() INTEGER: the position of the first character$(li)$(1)length$() INTEGER: the number of characters (optional, default the rest of the text)$(li)result $(1)result$() STRING: the part of the text
$(1)CALL c0de/strings/MID$(br)  PARAMETER text name ;$(br)  PARAMETER start 2 ;$(br)  PARAMETER length 3 ;$(br)  RESULT result part$()
